title: Timed canonizer completion
statement: Let $c$ be an effective machine code, and let $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean strings. Run the machine that parses a clock prefix and then executes $c$’s canonizer on the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$. After exactly $4|b|+3|\alpha|+8+c.\mathrm{canonizerTime}(|\alpha|)$ steps, it has halted, its output is the serialization of the machine decoded from $\alpha$, and its input head is at position $4|b|+2|\alpha|+7$; its clock tape contains $b$ starting at cell zero, with the tape head at position $|b|$.
